text: I am writing to respectfully request the installation of an all-way stop control at the intersection of Chadwick Ave and Gardiner Road. Residents have reached out to my office with concerns about pedestrian safety on their roadway, and they have presented my office with a petition with overwhelming support for the installation of all-way stop controls at the above-mentioned intersection.
The Toronto East York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way stop control at the intersection of Chadwick Avenue and Gardiner Road.
